text: The development of secondary sex characteristics at puberty is controlled mainly by:
explanation: Hormones from the gonads trigger the changes of puberty.

text: The principle that development proceeds from the head downwards to the feet is called:
explanation: Cephalocaudal means head to tail.

text: A student weak in sports works hard and excels in studies. This adjustment mechanism is:
explanation: Compensation makes up for a weakness in one area by excelling in another.

text: The term "identity crisis" was popularised by:
explanation: Erik Erikson used it for the adolescent search for identity.

text: Egocentrism, where the child finds it hard to take another's point of view, is a feature of Piaget's:
explanation: Egocentric thought is typical of children aged about 2 to 7.

text: Erikson's stage "industry versus inferiority" corresponds to the age of about:
explanation: Children in school years develop a sense of competence or inferiority.

text: In Kohlberg's pre-conventional level, moral reasoning is based on:
explanation: At this level right and wrong depend on consequences to oneself.

text: Information held for only a second or two after it is perceived is in:
explanation: Sensory memory holds raw sensory input very briefly.

text: According to the Yerkes-Dodson principle, performance is best when anxiety is:
explanation: A moderate level of arousal improves performance.

text: Interest in a subject is best described as:
options: A tendency to attend to and be involved with it
explanation: Interest is a motivating tendency to attend to something.

text: In Wallas's stages of the creative process, the sudden flash of the solution is called:
explanation: The stages are preparation, incubation, illumination and verification.

text: Convergent thinking usually leads to:
explanation: Convergent thinking narrows down to a single best answer.

text: In Skinner's experiments, a rat learns to press a lever to obtain food. This is:
explanation: Behaviour is shaped by its consequences: operant conditioning.

text: The Gestalt law that makes us perceive an incomplete figure as complete is the law of:
explanation: The mind fills in gaps to see a whole: closure.

text: The first of Gagne's nine events of instruction is:
explanation: Instruction begins by gaining attention.

text: A child with a specific learning disability usually has:
options: Normal or above-normal intelligence but difficulty in particular skills
explanation: Learning disability is unexpected difficulty in reading, writing or mathematics despite normal intelligence.

text: Which of the following helps a child with a hearing impairment most in class?
options: Visual aids and seating near the teacher
explanation: Visual support and good positioning compensate for reduced hearing.

text: Which sequence correctly shows the steps of teaching?
explanation: Teaching is planned, carried out and then evaluated.

text: A teacher who keeps updating his knowledge and skills plays the role of a:
explanation: Continuing learning keeps a teacher effective.

text: An authoritative teacher is one who:
options: Is warm and also sets and explains high expectations
explanation: The authoritative style combines warmth with clear standards.

text: Which of the following is a formative assessment technique?
options: A short class quiz during the unit
explanation: Formative assessment is done during learning to give feedback.

text: A debate in class mainly develops:
options: Reasoning and the ability to present arguments
explanation: Debates build argumentation and communication skills.

text: Which tool is commonly used to assess co-scholastic areas in CCE?
explanation: Checklists and rating scales record behaviour and skills.

text: Moving near a student who is talking in class to stop the behaviour is called:
explanation: Proximity control is a non-verbal, non-punitive management technique.

text: A balanced personality in a teacher is shown by:
options: Responding calmly to both praise and criticism
Being elated by praise and angry at criticism
explanation: Balance means steady, reasoned responses.

text: The National Curriculum Framework 2005 was prepared under the chairmanship of:
explanation: The NCF 2005 steering committee was chaired by Prof. Yash Pal.

text: The Right to Education Act came into force on:
explanation: The Act was passed in 2009 and came into effect on 1 April 2010.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ജലം ജീവന്റെ ആധാരമാണ്. എന്നാൽ ശുദ്ധജലത്തിന്റെ അളവ് ഭൂമിയിൽ വളരെ കുറവാണ്. അതുകൊണ്ട് ഓരോ തുള്ളി വെള്ളവും നാം സൂക്ഷിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കണം.” ഈ ഭാഗത്തിന്റെ സന്ദേശം എന്താണ്?
explanation: ശുദ്ധജലം കുറവായതിനാൽ അത് സൂക്ഷിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കണമെന്നാണ് അവസാനവാക്യം പറയുന്നത്.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഗ്രാമങ്ങളിൽ ആളുകൾ പരസ്പരം അറിയുന്നു. ഒരാളുടെ സങ്കടം എല്ലാവരുടെയും സങ്കടമാകുന്നു. നഗരത്തിലെ തിരക്കിൽ ഈ സ്നേഹബന്ധം കുറഞ്ഞു വരുന്നു.” ഖണ്ഡിക അനുസരിച്ച് നഗരത്തിൽ കുറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
explanation: അവസാനവാക്യത്തിൽ നഗരത്തിൽ സ്നേഹബന്ധം കുറഞ്ഞുവരുന്നു എന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ശാസ്ത്രം മനുഷ്യജീവിതം സുഖപ്രദമാക്കി. എന്നാൽ അതിന്റെ ദുരുപയോഗം വലിയ നാശത്തിനും കാരണമാകും. അതിനാൽ വിവേകത്തോടെ വേണം ശാസ്ത്രത്തെ ഉപയോഗിക്കാൻ.” ‘ദുരുപയോഗം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ അർഥം എന്താണ്?
explanation: ‘ദുർ’ എന്ന ഉപസർഗം ചീത്തയെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; ദുരുപയോഗം എന്നാൽ തെറ്റായ ഉപയോഗം.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഗ്രാമമെൻ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പച്ചപ്പായ് നിൽക്കുന്നു, പാടവും തോടും കിളികൾതൻ പാട്ടും; നഗരമോ തിരക്കിൻ ശബ്ദത്തിൽ മുങ്ങുന്നു, ഗ്രാമത്തിൻ ശാന്തത ഞാനോർത്തിടുന്നു.” കവി ഓർക്കുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
explanation: അവസാന വരിയിൽ ‘ഗ്രാമത്തിൻ ശാന്തത ഞാനോർത്തിടുന്നു’ എന്ന് കവി പറയുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “നഗരമോ തിരക്കിൻ ശബ്ദത്തിൽ മുങ്ങുന്നു.” ഇവിടെ നഗരത്തെ കവി എങ്ങനെ ചിത്രീകരിക്കുന്നു?
explanation: തിരക്കിന്റെ ശബ്ദത്തിൽ മുങ്ങുന്നു എന്നതിനാൽ ശബ്ദമുഖരിതമാണ്.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഗ്രാമമെൻ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ പച്ചപ്പായ് നിൽക്കുന്നു.” ഈ വരിയിൽ ‘പച്ചപ്പ്’ എന്നത് എന്തിനെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു?
explanation: ഗ്രാമം കവിയുടെ മനസ്സിൽ പച്ചപ്പായും ഓർമയായും നിൽക്കുന്നു എന്നാണ് ഭാവം.

text: ‘കണ്ണ്’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പര്യായമല്ലാത്തത് ഏത്?
explanation: നേത്രം, നയനം, ലോചനം എന്നിവ കണ്ണിന്റെ പര്യായങ്ങളാണ്.

text: ‘പ്രകാശം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം ഏത്?
explanation: പ്രകാശത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതം അന്ധകാരമാണ്.

text: ‘ഗ്രന്ഥം എഴുതുന്നവൻ’ എന്നതിന് ഒറ്റപ്പദം ഏത്?
explanation: ഗ്രന്ഥം എഴുതുന്നവൻ ഗ്രന്ഥകാരൻ.

text: ‘അച്ഛൻ എന്നെ വിളിച്ചു’ എന്ന വാക്യത്തിലെ കർത്താവ് ആര്?
explanation: ക്രിയ ചെയ്യുന്ന ആളാണ് കർത്താവ്; ഇവിടെ വിളിക്കുന്നത് അച്ഛനാണ്.

text: ഉചിതമായ പദം ചേർത്ത് വാക്യം പൂർത്തിയാക്കുക: “കടുത്ത വെയിൽ കാരണം ഞങ്ങൾ മരത്തണലിൽ ......”
explanation: വെയിലിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷതേടി തണലിൽ വിശ്രമിക്കുന്നതാണ് യുക്തിസഹം.

text: ‘എഴുതുന്നു’ എന്ന വർത്തമാനകാല ക്രിയയുടെ ഭൂതകാലരൂപം ഏത്?
explanation: ഭൂതകാലത്തിൽ ‘എഴുതി’ എന്ന രൂപം വരുന്നു.

text: ‘കുഞ്ഞ്’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ ബഹുവചനം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘കുഞ്ഞ്’ ന്റെ ബഹുവചനം ‘കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾ’.

text: ‘മണി + അറ = മണിയറ’ ഏത് സന്ധിക്ക് ഉദാഹരണം?
explanation: ‘യ്’ എന്ന വർണം പുതുതായി വരുന്നതിനാൽ ആഗമസന്ധി.

text: ‘മരത്തിൽ’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് വിഭക്തിയിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ‘-ഇൽ’ പ്രത്യയം ആധാരിക വിഭക്തിയുടേതാണ്.

text: ‘കണ്ണിൽ പൊടിയിടുക’ എന്ന ശൈലിയുടെ അർഥം ഏത്?
explanation: ഒരാളെ കബളിപ്പിച്ച് വഞ്ചിക്കുക എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ അർഥം.

text: ‘അരമനരഹസ്യം അങ്ങാടിപ്പാട്ട്’ എന്ന പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലിന്റെ ആശയം ഏത്?
explanation: രഹസ്യമായ കാര്യം പെട്ടെന്ന് എല്ലാവരും അറിയും എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ അർഥം.

text: ‘ചെമ്മീൻ’ എന്ന നോവൽ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: ചെമ്മീൻ തകഴിയുടെ പ്രശസ്തമായ നോവലാണ്.

text: ‘മാർത്താണ്ഡവർമ്മ’ എന്ന ചരിത്രനോവൽ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: മാർത്താണ്ഡവർമ്മ എഴുതിയത് സി. വി. രാമൻപിള്ളയാണ്.

text: ജ്ഞാനപീഠം പുരസ്കാരം നേടിയ ആദ്യ മലയാളി ആര്?
explanation: 1965-ൽ ‘ഓടക്കുഴൽ’ എന്ന കൃതിക്ക് ജി. ശങ്കരക്കുറുപ്പിന് ലഭിച്ചു.

text: Which of the following is a transverse wave?
explanation: Light is a transverse electromagnetic wave; sound waves in fluids are longitudinal.

text: The pitch of a sound depends on its:
explanation: Higher frequency means higher pitch; amplitude decides loudness.

text: An object is placed 20 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. The image is formed at a distance of:
The image formed by a plane mirror is:
options: Virtual, erect and of the same size
explanation: A plane mirror forms a virtual, erect image the same size as the object, laterally inverted.

text: A force of 100 N acts on an area of 0.5 m². The pressure is:
A temperature of 50 °C is equal to how many degrees Fahrenheit?
The area under a velocity-time graph gives the:
explanation: Area under the v-t graph is the displacement; the slope is the acceleration.

text: The momentum of a 2 kg body moving at 5 m/s is:
explanation: p = mv = 2 x 5 = 10 kg m/s.

text: If the distance between two masses is doubled, the gravitational force between them becomes:
explanation: F is proportional to 1/r², so doubling r reduces F to one-fourth.

text: A person holds a heavy load stationary for some time. The work done on the load by the person is:
explanation: There is no displacement, so W = Fs = 0.

text: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 5 Ω are connected in series. The total resistance is:
explanation: In series, resistances add: 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 Ω.

text: The SI unit of resistivity is:
explanation: Resistivity = RA/l, so the unit is ohm metre.

text: Two like magnetic poles:
explanation: Like poles repel; unlike poles attract.

text: Lenz's law is a consequence of the law of conservation of:
explanation: The induced current opposes the change that causes it, which conserves energy.

text: Alternating current supplied in India has a frequency of:
explanation: The mains frequency in India is 50 Hz.

text: When a p-n junction is forward biased, the depletion region:
explanation: Forward bias pushes carriers towards the junction, narrowing the depletion layer.

text: The main advantage of an integrated circuit (IC) is its:
options: Small size, low cost and reliability
explanation: Thousands of components fit on a tiny chip.

text: Which of the following is a chemical change?
explanation: Magnesium burns to form magnesium oxide, a new substance.

text: The atomic number of an element is the number of:
explanation: Atomic number equals the number of protons in the nucleus.

text: Thomson's model of the atom is often called the:
explanation: He imagined electrons embedded in a positively charged sphere.

text: Which metal can displace copper from a copper sulphate solution?
explanation: Zinc is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper.

text: The property of metals by which they can be drawn into thin wires is called:
explanation: Ductility is the ability to be drawn into wires; malleability is beating into sheets.

text: A solution contains 10 g of salt dissolved in 90 g of water. The mass percentage of salt is:
explanation: Mass percentage = 10 / (10 + 90) x 100 = 10%.

text: A mixture of sodium chloride and ammonium chloride can be separated by:
explanation: Ammonium chloride sublimes on heating, while sodium chloride does not.

text: The noble gases belong to group:
explanation: Helium, neon, argon and others are in group 18.

text: Across a period from left to right, ionisation energy generally:
explanation: Greater nuclear pull makes it harder to remove an electron.

text: A covalent bond is formed by:
explanation: Atoms share pairs of electrons to complete their octets.

text: In the laboratory, hydrogen chloride gas is prepared by heating sodium chloride with:
explanation: NaCl + H₂SO₄ gives NaHSO₄ + HCl.

text: Which gas is mainly responsible for the greenhouse effect?
explanation: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere, causing global warming.

text: Methane is the first member of the homologous series of:
explanation: CH₄ is the simplest alkane.

text: Antacid tablets are used to relieve acidity because they contain:
options: Bases that neutralise excess stomach acid
explanation: Mild bases such as magnesium hydroxide neutralise stomach acid.

text: "Equal volumes of all gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules." This is:
explanation: This statement is Avogadro's law.

text: The number of moles in 11 g of carbon dioxide (C = 12, O = 16) is:
explanation: Molar mass of CO₂ = 44 g, so 11 / 44 = 0.25 mol.

text: Which Indian scientist is associated with Bose statistics?
explanation: Bose's work with Einstein led to Bose-Einstein statistics.

text: In the revised Bloom's taxonomy, the highest cognitive level is:
explanation: The revised levels end with creating, above evaluating.

text: The recreational value of science teaching is achieved through:
explanation: Hobbies and clubs let pupils enjoy science in leisure time.

text: The practical value of science teaching is seen when a learner:
options: Applies science to daily life, for example in food preservation
explanation: The practical value links science to everyday needs.

text: Problem-based learning usually begins with:
explanation: Learners start from a real problem and work to solve it.

text: Piaget's theory suggests that teaching should be matched to the learner's:
explanation: Tasks should suit the child's stage of thinking.

text: Which of the following is an advantage of video lessons in science?
options: They can show processes that are hard to see directly
They remove the need for any teacher
explanation: Videos can show microscopic, distant or dangerous phenomena.

text: An important component at the end of a lesson plan is:
explanation: A lesson plan closes with evaluation and follow-up work.

text: The syntax of a teaching model, according to Joyce and Weil, refers to:
options: The sequence of phases or steps of the model
explanation: Syntax describes the phases of the model.

text: The inductive thinking model was developed by:
explanation: Hilda Taba's model teaches students to form concepts from data.

text: In the guided discovery method, the teacher:
options: Provides hints and questions but lets pupils find the answer
explanation: The teacher guides without telling the answer.

text: A limitation of the pure lecture method in science is that it:
explanation: Lectures make learners listeners rather than active participants.

text: Which method is best for developing manipulative skills?
explanation: Handling apparatus builds manipulative skill.

text: The integrated approach in science teaching presents:
options: Physics, chemistry and biology as parts of general science
explanation: It combines content from several branches into a unified whole.

text: A core curriculum is:
options: The set of essential learnings common to all learners
explanation: The core curriculum contains the common essentials for everyone.

text: The language of a good science textbook should be:
options: Suited to the learners' level and clear
explanation: Clear, graded language helps comprehension.

text: A school science library helps learners by providing:
options: Reference books and periodicals for self-study
explanation: A science library supports wider reading and self-study.

text: An achievement test measures:
explanation: An achievement test assesses learning of content and skills.

text: Open-book examinations mainly test:
options: Ability to apply and use information
explanation: Such tests focus on application, not recall.

text: Which of the following supports lifelong professional growth of a teacher?
options: Reading, research and participation in teacher forums
explanation: Continuous reading, research and sharing improve practice.
